summary: Registers the resources sync target as flat-reconcilable partitioned by json_extract($.type), with the partition scope resolved from --path-context object=<type> or CLARIFY_OBJECT, so a complete full sync prunes upstream-deleted records.
reason: Greptile P1 on PR #1747: empty flatReconcileModes left every mirror row non-reconcilable; Clarify has no tenant body column but the resources target is naturally partitioned by object type. Uses the generated resolveTenantID override hook.
validated_outcome: Live test: phantom local row of type person deleted by sync --full reconcile (event reconcile deleted=1, scope person); 50 real person rows untouched; unknown scope safely skips.
